scripts.build: npm run contracts:check && tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/stage-assets.mjs
scripts.contracts:generate: cargo run --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml -p rxchef-client --features schema --example export_contracts && node scripts/contracts.mjs
scripts.contracts:check: cargo run --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml -p rxchef-client --features schema --example export_contracts -- --check && node scripts/contracts.mjs --check
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && cargo build --locked --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml -p rxchef-server -p rxchef-cli --features rxchef-server/web-ui && playwright test
